title: Thin borders, rename nav label, remove banner text, fix admin access, show NFT address

requirements.text: Reduce all border and outline widths throughout the UI to half their current thickness. Any border currently at 2px should become 1px, any at 1px should become 0.5px, and so on proportionally. Apply this consistently across cards, buttons, inputs, modals, and any other bordered elements.

quotes: Die Umrandungen sind noch zu fett, bitte um die Hälfte dünner!

acceptanceCriteria: All visible borders and outlines appear visually half as thick as in version 59
No element retains its previous border width
Cards, inputs, modals, and buttons all reflect the thinner borders

requirements.text: Rename the navigation label for the home/gallery route from 'Galerie' to 'Startseite' in the Navigation component and any other place this label appears in the UI (page titles, breadcrumbs, tab labels, etc.).

quotes: Die Startseite soll nicht 'Galerie' heissen, sondern 'Startseite'

acceptanceCriteria: The navigation link for the home/gallery page reads 'Startseite'
No other UI element labels this page 'Galerie' (except the NFT Gallery sub-page if it is a separate route)

requirements.text: Remove the 'Galerie' text overlay/label rendered on top of the hero banner image on the Gallery/Startseite page. The banner should display only the image without this text.
acceptanceCriteria: The hero banner on the Gallery/Startseite page contains no 'Galerie' heading or text overlay
The banner image is otherwise unchanged

requirements.text: Fix admin access control so that the authenticated admin user is correctly granted access to the Admin Dashboard. Investigate the useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook and AdminDashboard page: ensure the hardcoded principal fallback and timeout logic correctly match the logged-in user's principal. If the principal comparison is case-sensitive or formatted differently, normalize it. Add clear console logging or UI messaging so the current principal and the expected admin principal can be compared during debugging.

quotes: Admin Bereich verweigert weiterhin den Zugriff

acceptanceCriteria: The logged-in admin user is granted access to the Admin Dashboard without being denied
The admin check resolves correctly and does not time out for the legitimate admin user
Non-admin users are still correctly denied access

requirements.text: Display the NFT canister/contract address (principal ID of the backend canister) visibly in the UI. Show it in a prominent but non-intrusive location such as the footer, the NFT Gallery page header, or the NFT detail modal. Use the existing PrincipalDisplay component with copy-to-clipboard support. The label should read 'NFT Contract Address' or 'Canister Address'.

quotes: Wo ist die Adresse des NFT?

acceptanceCriteria: The backend canister principal ID is visible somewhere in the UI (footer or NFT Gallery page)
The address can be copied to clipboard using the PrincipalDisplay component
The label clearly identifies this as the NFT contract/canister address

constraints: Do not change the backend data model or NFT minting logic
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall visual theme or color palette
Adding new NFT features or minting flows
Changing the NFT Gallery sub-page route or its functionality
